//! @generated — state dan event. `State` adalah satu-satunya tempat yang
//! berubah saat aplikasi berjalan; `Component` tetap statis.

use super::NodeId;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Value {
    Text(String),
    Number(f32),
    Bool(bool),
}

impl Value {
    pub fn as_text(&self) -> String {
        match self {
            Self::Text(text) => text.clone(),
            Self::Number(value) => format!("{value}"),
            Self::Bool(value) => value.to_string(),
        }
    }

    pub fn as_bool(&self) -> bool {
        match self {
            Self::Bool(value) => *value,
            Self::Number(value) => *value != 0.0,
            Self::Text(text) => !text.is_empty(),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct State {
    values: BTreeMap<String, Value>,
    pub hovered: Option<NodeId>,
    pub focused: Option<NodeId>,
    pub pressed: Option<NodeId>,
}

impl State {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    /// Isi nilai awal dari binding yang ditemukan di desain.
    pub fn with_bindings<I, S>(bindings: I) -> Self
    where
        I: IntoIterator<Item = S>,
        S: Into<String>,
    {
        let mut state = Self::new();
        for key in bindings {
            state.set(key.into().as_str(), Value::Text(String::new()));
        }
        state
    }

    pub fn set(&mut self, key: &str, value: Value) {
        self.values.insert(key.to_string(), value);
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<&Value> {
        self.values.get(key)
    }

    pub fn text(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        self.values.get(key).map(Value::as_text)
    }

    pub fn bool(&self, key: &str, default: bool) -> bool {
        self.values.get(key).map(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(default)
    }

    pub fn is_hovered(&self, id: NodeId) -> bool {
        self.hovered == Some(id)
    }

    pub fn is_pressed(&self, id: NodeId) -> bool {
        self.pressed == Some(id)
    }

    pub fn is_focused(&self, id: NodeId) -> bool {
        self.focused == Some(id)
    }
}

/// Event yang dikirim dari `app` ke `user::handlers`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Event {
    PointerDown(NodeId),
    PointerUp(NodeId),
    Hover(Option<NodeId>),
    Key(String),
    TextInput(NodeId, String),
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn state_resolves_values() {
        let mut state = State::new();
        state.set("name", Value::Text("Dunia".into()));
        state.set("count", Value::Number(3.0));
        assert_eq!(state.text("name").as_deref(), Some("Dunia"));
        assert_eq!(state.text("count").as_deref(), Some("3"));
        assert!(!state.bool("missing", false));
    }
}
